recentItems.title: Ex-Prisoners Kranthi & Veeraiah Emotional Interview | Jail Life | Crime Confessions With Muralidhar
recentItems.description:
#idreamnews #idreamupdates #idreammediainterviews #teluguinterviews 
Ex-Prisoners Kranthi & Veeraiah Emotional Interview | Jail Life | Crime Confessions With Muralidhar
#jaillife  #prisonstories  #rajahmundrycentraljail 

In this emotional and eye-opening episode of iDream – Jail Changed Lives, two former prisoners, Veeranna and Kranthi, share their real-life experiences of spending nearly five years in Rajahmundry Central Jail.

From murder cases and life imprisonment to love, family struggles, loneliness and emotional pain, they reveal the harsh realities of prison life.

They also explain how prison officials helped them transform their lives through counselling, discipline, vocational training, yoga and rehabilitation programs.

In this episode:
- Why did Veeranna end up in a murder case?
- How did five years in prison change his attitude and behaviour?
- What happens inside Rajahmundry Central Jail?
- How do prisoners deal with loneliness after lockdown?
- Kranthi's heartbreaking story of love and a tragic suicide case.
- How prison officials support inmates through counselling.
- What skills and vocational training do prisoners learn?
- How difficult is life for families of prisoners?
- What challenges do former prisoners face after release?
- What message do they have for today's youth?
Their powerful message: Don't wait until you enter prison to change your life. Think about your family, your future and the consequences before making a wrong decision.

Watch this inspiring and emotional conversation about mistakes, regret, transformation and second chances.
